Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: if the size of the new and old models differs, you'll need to buy a new protective case.

Users upgrading to the iPhone 18 Pro this year will almost inevitably need to buy a new case — but two accessory makers have different views on this, and one has even made a bolder prediction...

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, noting that the product is already listed on Best Buy and is marked as compatible with the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging is labelled in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself is not entirely convinced, adding: "It's still too early to jump to conclusions." However, Matt Ronge, founder of Astropad — a company that primarily makes anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones — said his suppliers told him the same thing.

iPhone Pro body thickness remains a contentious issue

Last year, a leaker claimed the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. The report did not mention the smaller Pro model, but sources in the iPhone supply chain indicated the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimetres thicker than its predecessor.

This trend seems to continue, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers agree with this — some claim the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's view

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers with dimension data in advance so that third-party cases can launch alongside the new iPhone. On the other hand, accessory makers sometimes place orders based purely on rumours, and the accuracy may not be reliable. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
